honest_verdict: Most of what the first pass called absent had been deleted on 2026-07-29 by 8b0c5405, whose message describes the removals as retiring historical recovery executables. Restoring it brings the ramanujan suite to 146 passing tests and closes roles, all seven stores, search, Forge, sovereignty, economics, limits, the train package and the whole data pipeline. What is genuinely unbuilt is the formalizer controller and the repair controller, and what is genuinely blocked is Q1 and Q2, which have no definition to build against.
